tyk-authentication-enabled.description: The Gateway must authenticate every request to this API.
tyk-authentication-enabled.howToFix: Set x-tyk-api-gateway.server.authentication.enabled to true and enable at least one security scheme under it.

tyk-operation-id-required.description: Tyk keys per-operation middleware by operationId.
tyk-operation-id-required.howToFix: Add a unique operationId to every operation.

tyk-upstream-https.description: The Gateway should reach the upstream over TLS.
tyk-upstream-https.message: x-tyk-api-gateway.upstream.url does not start with https://.
tyk-upstream-https.howToFix: Point x-tyk-api-gateway.upstream.url at an https:// address.

tyk-api-rate-limit.description: Every API should carry an API-level rate limit.
tyk-api-rate-limit.howToFix: Add x-tyk-api-gateway.upstream.rateLimit with enabled, rate and per.
